description: Part of the standard (base-repo-standard): only where CI runs the repo's tests on pull requests.

packageRules.description: Minor, patch, pin and digest-pin updates merge on green CI, 0.x dependencies like any other, all in one PR per repository (every PR costs CI runs)
Docker digest updates (same tag, rebuilt image) merge on green CI in the same PR; other digests wait for a human (default.json, upstream-repush)
Weekly lockfile refresh merges on green CI
